changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO themes ( tenant_id, name, is_active, primary_color, secondary_color, accent_color, background_color, text_color, sidebar_bg_color, sidebar_text_color, sidebar_active_color, sidebar_hover_color, header_bg_color, header_text_color, footer_bg_color, footer_text_color, surface_color, border_color, hover_color, link_color, error_color, success_color, warning_color, info_color, font_family, font_url, border_radius, dark_mode, created_at, updated_at ) SELECT id, 'Emirates ERP Teal', true, '#00A9A8', '#ffffff', '#02888D', '#F7FAFF', '#18233B', '#003E5B', '#F2F5FA', '#00A9A8', '#002D42', '#ffffff', '#18233B', '#ffffff', '#607089', '#ffffff', '#DBE5F3', '#F7FAFF', '#008180', '#FF3B3B', '#00A9A8', '#FFA713', '#3b82f6', 'Inter', 'https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:wght@300;400;500;600;700&display=swap', '11px', false, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP FROM tenants WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM themes WHERE themes.tenant_id = tenants.id );
